title: Fake Tour Guide Deposit
scenario: A guide on social media asks for full bank-transfer payment for a popular tour.

answers.A: Transfer the full amount to reserve the tour today.
answers.B: Book through a verified platform with payment protection.
answers.C: Send a small deposit first and pay the rest on arrival.
answers.D: Meet the guide through a hotel or official tourism referral and confirm the terms.

explanation: A social profile is not proof that a tour exists. Use a protected booking channel and keep the payment tied to clear terms.
proTip: A smaller scam is still a scam; protection matters more than deposit size.
